## About

**Gross Environmental Product** maps urban ecology across Heilbronn's districts and scores
each one on a **Gross Ecosystem Product (GEP)** — a GDP-style index (EUR/ha·a) for the value
of its ecosystem services. District boundaries, green space and water come from
OpenStreetMap; NDVI and soil sealing are derived from Sentinel-2 (Copernicus) and combined
via zonal statistics into the per-district GEP score. Built as an application demo for the
**GEP@HHN** project (Hochschule Heilbronn, ref. 314-IB) on GIS and urban ecology.
